name: dkg-claude-code-memory
description: MCP server providing Claude Code agents with persistent, verifiable Working Memory on OriginTrail DKG v10. Captures research findings, vulnerability analyses, and code reviews with SHA-256 content-addressable IDs, PROV-O provenance chains, and multi-agent attribution — enabling cross-session retrieval, deduplication, and team knowledge sharing.
author: drMurlly

DKG_WM_CONTEXT_GRAPH.description: Named graph for Working Memory isolation (default: ccm-research)

DKG_WM_AUTHOR_ID.description: Human-readable author identifier written to provenance metadata

DKG_WM_AGENT_ID.description: Agent identifier written to prov:wasAttributedTo quads (default: claude-code-agent)

networkEgress.description: JSON-RPC calls to the OriginTrail DKG node for reading and writing knowledge assets

writeAuthority.description: Writes knowledge assets to the OriginTrail DKG v10 blockchain under the authenticated user's DKG wallet. All writes are scoped to the configured DKG_WM_CONTEXT_GRAPH named graph.

tools.name: capture_research_finding
tools.description: Write a research artifact (finding, decision, vulnerability, synthesis) to DKG Working Memory with SHA-256 content hash, PROV-O derivedFrom chains, sensitivity classification, and multi-agent attribution metadata

tools.name: search_working_memory
tools.description: Search past artifacts by keyword, type, status, session ID, or provenance chain (derivedFromId). Call at the start of any research task to avoid duplicating prior work.

tools.name: retrieve_artifact
tools.description: Retrieve the full content and metadata of a single artifact by its artifactId or UAL reference

tools.name: update_artifact_status
tools.description: Advance an artifact through the trust gradient: draft → needs_sources → review_needed → validated → ready_to_share (or deprecate/discard)

tools.name: promote_to_shared_memory
tools.description: Promote a validated artifact from private Working Memory to team-shared Shared Memory. Requires explicit user confirmation (confirm: true). Blocks confidential artifacts.

tools.name: synthesize_session
tools.description: Synthesize session artifacts into a structured report with typeCounts

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of session artifacts with typeCounts

tools.name: query_shared_memory
tools.description: Search Shared Memory by keyword — finds promoted artifacts matching the query in their title or text content

tools.name: get_claim_review
tools.description: Generate a schema.org ClaimReview JSON-LD document for any stored artifact — enables direct consumption by the OriginTrail Oracle for Verified Memory integration

tools.name: get_node_status
tools.description: Check DKG node reachability and measure connection latency — useful for diagnosing connection issues before running tool operations

capabilities.deduplication: SHA-256 content-addressable IDs prevent duplicate captures across sessions
capabilities.provenance: PROV-O prov:wasDerivedFrom chains link artifacts across multi-agent hierarchies
capabilities.sensitivity: Three-tier access control (public/internal/confidential) with promotion guard
capabilities.claimReview: schema.org ClaimReview serialization ready for OriginTrail Oracle integration
